rows.binding_vritti: āśā as grasping / clinging hope — goaded toward a specific outcome or object; the downward pull of attached desire
rows.liberating_vritti: aspiring hope held WITHOUT attachment — forward-orientation that acts while releasing the grip on the result (oriented toward the Great, not the object)
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: cintā as anxious rumination — the mind churning over unresolved contingencies and personal consequences (e.g. worrying through the late-train inconveniences), gripping the what-ifs
rows.liberating_vritti: cintā as composed, impersonal reflection — holding an unsettled situation open without forcing premature closure; objective contemplation in which one is 'not a direct player' (e.g. weighing how a failing industry might be revived), reflection without anxious grip
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: restless striving that cannot stop — effort compulsively driven on, unable to cease (and, clung to mundane ends, ceaseless outward striving)
rows.liberating_vritti: will-force applied to arouse one's dormant higher potential — purposeful effort that exerts and then rests into poised, alert repose without inertia; the effort behind spiritual elevation
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: mamatā bounded by the relative factors (time, space, individuality) — partial, possessive 'mine-ness' that clings to its own (own child, own country, own moment) while excluding or even harming what lies outside it
rows.liberating_vritti: mamatā made to TRANSCEND time, space and individuality — love expanded past its relative boundaries into universal affection that holds the loved on an open hand (achievable only by human beings, through persistent, intense effort)
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: dambha as vanity — the self displayed and performed for others' eyes; conduct staged to be seen and admired
rows.liberating_vritti: conduct that stands without outward performance — action done for its own sake, needing no audience or applause
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: viveka distorted — discernment hardening into judgmentalism / separation-pride (discrimination used to feel superior to others)
rows.liberating_vritti: falsehood-discerning insight without egoic superiority — clear conscience distinguishing real from unreal, held without pride
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: collapse of mental function under strain — the mind that had functioned properly begins to malfunction or stops altogether
rows.liberating_vritti: steadiness that keeps mental function intact under load — holding the mind operational under a strain that would otherwise break it
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: the inflated 'I did / I control this' — the 'I'-feeling swollen into sole doership (as in Aurangzeb: 'had I not been there the world would have been destroyed')
rows.liberating_vritti: agency exercised WITHOUT inflating the 'I' — acting and functioning while not claiming sole doership
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: greed / avarice — hoarding accumulation without limit; the insatiable greedy fascination (nolā) that always wants more
rows.liberating_vritti: sufficiency — appetite that releases at 'enough'; wanting stilled at contentment, the surplus grip let go
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: hypocrisy / concealment — inner and outer diverging: cheating to serve one's purpose, domineering to hide one's own weakness, condemning in others the sins one secretly commits
rows.liberating_vritti: transparency — inner intent and outer act coincide; no pretense, being what one appears
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: vitarka — overstating one's case to the point of garrulousness; bad-tempered, exaggerated over-talk beyond what is warranted (the abusive over-response)
rows.liberating_vritti: pramita vāk — balanced, measured speech using only relevant words; saying just what is warranted (the helpful, to-the-point reply)
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: anutāpa as gripping remorse — the 'after-heat' that torments, replaying one's own past wrong without release
rows.liberating_vritti: repentance discharged into acceptance — the remorse over one's past act released, the realization-of-impropriety turned into amendment rather than endless self-torment
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: lajjā as inhibition — action held back by others' regard; shrinking, self-conscious shame that blocks natural conduct
rows.liberating_vritti: acting unhindered by social shame — natural, unselfconscious conduct; healthy modesty without inhibition
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: piśunatā — senseless, sadistic cruelty: harming/killing with gratuitous torture (dismembering a creature piece by piece; impaling, flaying), inflicting maximal suffering for its own sake; malice toward the maligned
rows.liberating_vritti: compassion that shields the maligned — restraint from gratuitous cruelty; if life must be taken, with the minimum of pain (the spirit of Neohumanism)
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: envy — the sting at another's success; covetous resentment at another's good fortune
rows.liberating_vritti: muditā — sympathetic gladness at another's fortune; rejoicing in others' good rather than being stung by it
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: jāḍya — inertia, staticity, dullness, torpor: the deep sleep of mind, intellectual dullness and spiritual inertness
rows.liberating_vritti: the cessation of dullness/staticity — awakening from torpor into expansion (tan); alert wakefulness rising from torpor (the movement that liberates from jāḍya, which the word 'Tantra' names)
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: viśāda — melancholy, dejection that sinks one's own mood; gloom, the sinking of spirits
rows.liberating_vritti: warm buoyancy lifting one's own dejection — the mood rising out of melancholy into brightness
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: peevishness / reactive irritability — perverse, contrary reactivity discharged at others (taking offence at kindness, calm under harshness)
rows.liberating_vritti: forbearance that absorbs provocation — an even, unreactive temper that does not discharge irritation
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: tṛṣṇā — limitless thirst to acquire: unquenchable craving for wealth, name, fame, power and prestige (not thirst for water)
rows.liberating_vritti: the acquisitive thirst quenched at its root — all thoughts (pure and impure) redirected wholly toward the Supreme (Parama Puruṣa), the attested cure
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: moha — blind attachment / infatuation: the mind fixated on an object, place, time or idea, losing rationality (geo-sentiment; nostalgia for an age; the thief drawn back to the scene; fascination for a battered object)
rows.liberating_vritti: de-fascination from false attraction — superimposing indifference and diverting the mind toward Parama Puruṣa (the attested cure); freedom from fixation
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: ghṛṇā — the fetter of hatred / revulsion: hatred arising (mainly from frustrated moha) and the downward pull toward the crude (pat / patati -> downfall)
rows.liberating_vritti: the upward turn — goodwill that dissolves revulsion; anurakti (attraction for the Great) consummating in devotion (ūrdhva gam)
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: bhaya — fear: collapse or flight before danger; the shrinking, dread and panic under threat
rows.liberating_vritti: abhaya — steadiness meeting a genuine threat; unshaken presence in the face of danger
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: avajñā — neglect / disregard of what actually has value; indifference misapplied so that genuine worth goes unattended
rows.liberating_vritti: regard that recognizes and attends to worth — giving due attention to what has value (and reserving indifference/upekṣā only for the truly unacceptable)
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: mūrcchā — hypnotic entrancement, the loss of common sense / discernment under the spell of a ripu (deluded obsession that suspends judgment)
rows.liberating_vritti: breaking the entrancing spell into clear sense — withdrawing the mind (pratyāhāra) along the path of righteousness, no longer spellbound (aided by kīrtana / devotional song)
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: praśraya / praṇāśa — giving latitude to the point of dissolution; unrestrained indulgence that runs to annihilating collapse
rows.liberating_vritti: disciplined containment that holds form — latitude restrained and sublimated so the dissolving tendency is contained rather than annihilating
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: aviśvāsa — self-doubt that cannot commit: lack of confidence and wavering ('shall I be able to do it?'), distrust of self and others
rows.liberating_vritti: self-efficacy — the confidence to commit and to rely: steady trust in oneself, others and the path
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: sarvanāśa — the defeatist annihilation-thought ('I have nothing, everything is gone, I am undone'); destructive collapse, the sense of total defeat
rows.liberating_vritti: prāṇaśakti — the fire of life-force directed as vitality and winning resolve ('I have come to win, I am destined to win'; 'Parama Puruṣa is mine'); directed energy without bondage
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: kruratā — cruelty: physical harm inflicted on the weak; crude, cruel thought and behaviour
rows.liberating_vritti: compassion (karuṇā) that protects the vulnerable — the counter-measure to cruelty; the will to reduce another's misery and help arouse their latent intellect
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: ensconcement gone rigid — over-holding, clinging to one's holding; stuck fixity that resists the movement toward subtlety
rows.liberating_vritti: dharma — ensconcement in one's original (true) stance; the sustaining principle ('that which sustains'), the unbroken movement toward subtlety and merger into Parama Puruṣa (mānava dharma)
rows.empirical_status_note: v3.1 consonant backbone (b1_2 source + operator primary-text corrections); used in the B1 line (see B1.10 control-extension result).

rows.binding_vritti: artha as possessive acquisition — worldly purpose pursued and possessed as acquisition, status or control (rajasic grasping to acquire)
rows.liberating_vritti: purposeful action without possessive bondage — rajasic energy directed to legitimate purpose/means without clinging (artha pursued without attachment)
